items.description: Australian officials ask fans to respect the privacy of Neil, a trouble-making seal NPR Watch Neil the Seal wreak havoc in Tasmania USA Today Australian officials ask fans to respect privacy of Neil, a 1000kg seal, who respects nothing The Times of India Tasmanians warned of ‘loving Neil to death’ as 1,000kg seal’s antics feed ‘double-edged sword’ of fame The Guardian Famous elephant seal makes annual visit to Tasmania, causing chaos upi.com
items.description_zh: 澳大利亚官员要求粉丝们尊重一只爱惹麻烦的海豹尼尔的隐私 NPR 观看《今日美国》观看尼尔海豹在塔斯马尼亚造成的严重破坏 澳大利亚官员要求粉丝们尊重一只 1000 公斤重的海豹尼尔的隐私，它不尊重任何东西 印度时报 塔斯马尼亚人警告说，1000 公斤海豹的滑稽动作给《卫报》带来了“双刃剑”，塔斯马尼亚人警告说，人们“爱死尼尔了” 著名的象海豹每年都会到访澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚，造成混乱 upi.com
